title.romaji: GENJI FANTASY: Neko ga Hikaru Genji ni Koi wo Shita

media.description:
The Tale of Genji Museum in Uji City, Kyoto will be airing a short film blending history and fantasy, the story follows a modern high school girl named Hana who is transformed into a cat and transported back in time. She travels 1,000 years ago to the Heian Era as portrayed in The Tale Of Genji, arguably the most famous novel in Japanese literature. Guided by the novel's titular character Hikaru Genji, Hana experiences firsthand the emotions that the author Murasaki Shikibu depicted in her novel. The short features scenes based on The Diary of Lady Murasaki and other historical materials, such as the real-life noble Fujiwara no Michinaga swiping early drafts of The Tale Of Genji because he could not wait to read chapters as Murasaki wrote them.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title.english: The Haunted House: The Sky Ghost VS Jormungandr

media.description:
Hsiao Hsia, a girl in the fifth grade, pretend to be "Venusians" during their summer vacation, playing pranks on adults troubled with love.

Unexpectedly, their pranks succeed, making the Venusians famous and leading to the establishment of the "Venusians Agency", where they start offering advice to those troubled with love.

However, on the seventh day before the summer vacation ends, Hsia becomes troubled by her own worries. Her life as a Venusian continues until she meets a blonde woman named Ching Tien. After they resonate with each other's struggles, things start to change. For both of them, the meaning of "love" will be revealed, and they will find their own answers.

(Source: 24.5 Image Production YouTube Channel, translated)

title.romaji: Arifureta Shokugyou de Sekai Saikyou Picture Drama

media.description:
An online motion graphic series that provides a comedic interpretation of events that have occurred in conjunction with the anime.

Note: These episodes were originally posted on the series' official Twitter page on a weekly basis coinciding with the anime's broadcast, and were later included in the BD-BOX sets 1 through 3.
